ValidationRule.description: Location is required when Status is 'Close' or 'Closure Pending'
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closed') , ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Closure Pending') ), NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, "Master Data"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "EDI") ) ), NOT( AND( ISPICKVAL(PMC_SS_IssueReason__c, "MDM Verification"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Internal") ) ), ISBLANK(PMC_SS_Location__c), RecordType.DeveloperName = 'PMC_SS_CaseGeneral', Account.BillingCountry!='Brazil', Account.BillingCountry!='Paraguay' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Location is required to close out your case.
